title: Hand-written float offsets ignore the 16-byte alignment of vec4 slicePlane after a new f32 field
expected_finding: the host writes slicePlane at float 36 and sparkle/growth/aberration/grain at 40-43, but the shader's Uniforms has dopamineTrails at 36, slicePlane at 40 (byte 160) and sparkle.. at 44-47: every field from the clip plane on is four floats low and dopamineTrails is never written
